prompt: Name a U.S. Navy destroyer, destroyer escort or frigate (a USS ship)
note: Any U.S. Navy destroyer, destroyer escort or frigate with its own English Wikipedia article counts, under the name Wikipedia gives it (for example USS Missouri). Several ships of the same name are one answer. "USS" may be left off.

answers.name: USS Swasey
answers.note: The first USS Swasey (DD-273) was a Clemson-class destroyer later transferred to the Royal Navy as HMS Rockingham.
